svg.title: Fig. 4 — frozen Qwen3.5-9B with trained temporal finding probe

cc:Work.dc:title: Fig. 4 — frozen Qwen3.5-9B with trained temporal finding probe
cc:Work.dc:description: Actual held-out MIMIC-CXR case. Frozen completed Qwen3.5-9B MedWorld slots checkpoint and a new supervised finding probe. Only Day 0 image/report and elapsed time enter forecasts. Follow-ups are references. Probability text is a template, not a generated report. No 9B no-slots model is evaluated. Lexicographically first eligible held-out patient; earliest four distinct studies with existing source images, ordered by timestamp/study/image ID. No labels, reports, outcomes, or model predictions enter selection.
